description: gitlab CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record): the stack this plugin's own tests run in. Installs the depends_on closure (identity_core; aws_core and the computing_core it depends on), each from git at a pinned full commit, and gitlab itself; the consumer flips self to editable so the checkout under test runs, not the pinned revision. Population seeds gitlab's page bundle, which proves it imports. The only network access is the install of those pinned revisions; nothing seeded or tested reaches the network. Deliberately excluded: every other plugin and all credentials.

steps.note: gitlab's own bundle: the /gitlab page, its panels, searches and projection.
